description: Megethia wears an opaque burgundy floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, naturally fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold geometric and scrolling embroidered borders trace the neckline, front bodice seams, cuffs, waist and vertical skirt opening. Decorative round brooches sit near the shoulder corners. A thin decorated girdle with a large circular clasp secures the waist. A pale cream wrap with burgundy and gold borders rests around her forearms. A narrow cream underdress panel is visible down the lower front. A small pendant and bracelet provide modest jewelry. Dark embroidered flat shoes peek beneath the hem; her head is uncovered.
